metodologia.title: Methodology
metodologia.metaDescription: Every figure keeps its source, date, and reliability tier. Numbers are never overwritten — disagreements between sources are logged, not hidden.
metodologia.intro1: A disaster's numbers change from source to source and from day to day — that doesn't always mean an error. This site never overwrites a number with a newer one: every number is recorded with its source, its date, and its reliability level, and the most recent one is shown without erasing the history.
metodologia.intro2: When two reliable sources disagree on the same data point, we log it as a discrepancy instead of silently picking one. Some are resolved as more information comes in; others stay open until a definitive number exists.
metodologia.quienesTexto: SOSColombia is an independent volunteer project — it is not a registered NGO, a Colombian government entity, or affiliated with UNGRD or any news outlet. It gathers and cross-checks figures from official bulletins (UNGRD, Medicina Legal/INMLCF, SGC, DANE), international humanitarian reports (OCHA, UNICEF, Cruz Roja Colombiana), local governments, and press and social-media sources, and republishes them always with their source cited.
metodologia.nivelesTexto: Every source carries a reliability tier, from 1 (official primary source) to 6 (unverified social media) — see the <link>full source list</link>.
